author: Vox
description:
Texas Tech University was given an F for free speech on campus by the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE). Greg Lukianoff, the president and CEO of FIRE, explains why universities like Texas Tech are struggling with free speech — and the role the government plays in it.
